findings.claim: CDC source epochs containing hyphens are rejected, so the new integration test and the documented example epoch fail catalog validation before replication starts.
findings.evidence: validate_config permits only ASCII alphanumeric characters or `"._:"` (`.all(|character| character.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "._:".contains(character))`), but the test config uses hyphenated epochs such as `"c008-core-v1"` in `crates/frf-gateway/tests/cdc_integration.rs` and `.env.example` sets `FRF_CDC_SOURCE_EPOCH=replace-with-stable-slot-epoch`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either include `-` in the allowed epoch character set (for example `"._:-"`) or change all configured/test/example epochs to match the validator.

findings.claim: The reference Compose profile still requires PostgreSQL CDC DSN inputs even when CDC is disabled by default.
findings.evidence: The diff changes `CDC_ENABLED` to `"${FRF_CDC_ENABLED:-false}"`, but `CDC_REPLICATION_URL` still interpolates `${FRF_POSTGRES_USER:?FRF_POSTGRES_USER is required}`, `${FRF_POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?FRF_POSTGRES_PASSWORD is required}`, and `${FRF_POSTGRES_DB:?FRF_POSTGRES_DB is required}` unconditionally; acceptance/evidence states the profile now defaults CDC off and accepts empty disabled-mode inputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `:?` requirements from the CDC_REPLICATION_URL interpolation when CDC is disabled, e.g. default the URL to an empty string unless `FRF_CDC_ENABLED=true`, and rely on gateway validation to require it only when enabled.
